value.rationale: A sharp price-induced nonuniqueness and edge-deletion transition with all optimal conductances in a minimal nontrivial odd cycle is a motivated spectral optimization classification. The exact critical 16 and continuum of optimizers supply useful structural boundary data beyond merely computing a numerical SDP.

final_claim: For symmetric continuous-time fastest mixing on C5 under budget four unit-price edges plus one closing edge price t>0, explicit unique interior optimum for t<16, unique deleted-edge path optimum for t>16, and exactly a nontrivial optimal line segment at t=16.
limitations: Only symmetric continuous-time rates on C5 with 4 unit prices/one exceptional price and unit stationary masses; not discrete-time SLEM or general edge-cost vectors.
No exhaustive global priority proof; special weighted-C5 literature overlap remains bounded risk.
